result.title: EAGLE: Entity-Aware Grounding with Layered Evidence for High-Resolution Image Understanding
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle with fine-grained understanding of high-resolution images: attention heads vary in their reliability for grounding target entities and their attributes, while localized details are often disconnected from the broader scene context. We propose EAGLE (Entity-Aware Grounding with Layered Evidence for High-Resolution Image Understanding), a plug-in framework that jointly selects grounding signals and organizes hierarchical visual evidence. EAGLE employs a fine-grained dataset to screen visually-grounded attention heads, followed by entity-aware grounding to extract target-specific regions. It then integrates hierarchical evidence construction and question-guided routing to select optimal view combinations, feeding them into the frozen MLLM to enhance fine-grained visual understanding. Experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3-8B demonstrate that EAGLE consistently improves performance across both backbones and achieves SOTA results on V*, HRBench-4K, and HRBench-8K compared with existing methods using the same backbone.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EAGLE 即插件框架：先用细粒度数据筛选可靠定位的注意力头，按实体提取目标区域，再构建分层视觉证据并用问题引导的路由选择视图组合，输入冻结的 MLLM 以提升高分辨率图像细粒度理解。
AI.relevance_reason: 「注意力头可靠性筛选＋实体级证据选择＋按问题路由视图」与视觉证据筛选、注意力结构与证据获取决策直接相关，可供核查视觉证据如何进入 VLM 推理而非被旁路；但方法停留在输入侧证据组织，未涉及 latent 状态生成。
